privacy.metaDescription: What Apex stores in your browser, what it sends to analytics providers, and your choices.
privacy.title: Privacy, explained without the small print.
privacy.intro: This page describes what Apex does with information about your visit. It is written for Turkish users under KVKK and for users in the European Economic Area under GDPR. It is not a substitute for advice from your legal counsel.
privacy.s1Title: Analytics is off until you accept
privacy.s1p1: Apex uses two optional Vercel services: Web Analytics (anonymous page views) and Speed Insights (page performance measurements). Neither is loaded, and no request is made to them, until you press Accept in the notice shown on your first visit.
privacy.s1p2: If you press Decline, or do nothing, they stay off. You can change your choice at any time with the Analytics settings link in the footer.
privacy.s2Title: What is stored in your browser
privacy.s2p1: Your consent choice is saved in your browser's local storage under the name apex-analytics-consent (value granted or denied). It stays on your device and is not sent to Apex servers. The story reader may also keep your reading-language preference in local storage. The language routing may keep a language cookie so the site opens in the language you chose. If your browser blocks storage, your choice applies only to the current page view.
privacy.s2p2: Apex does not use advertising cookies, does not sell personal data and does not build advertising profiles.
privacy.s3p1: Like any website, Apex's hosting and security layers process technical request data such as IP address, browser type, requested page and time, to deliver the site, limit abuse and keep it reliable. Hosting, database and error-monitoring providers process data only to provide their service.
privacy.s3p2: Processing relies on legitimate interest for security and operation, and on your consent for the optional analytics described above. We keep data only as long as the stated purpose needs.
privacy.s4p1: Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or objection; withdraw consent; and complain to the Turkish Data Protection Authority (KVKK) or your local supervisory authority. We may need to verify a request before acting on it.
privacy.s4p2: Send privacy requests to <mail>privacy@apexstats.example</mail>. This address is a placeholder and must be replaced with a monitored mailbox before launch.

disclaimer.title: Independent, unofficial and unaffiliated.
disclaimer.intro: Apex is an independent statistics, telemetry and editorial archive project for motorsport fans. It is not an official Formula 1 website and has no commercial, licensing, sponsorship or endorsement relationship with Formula 1, Formula One Licensing B.V., the FIA, any team, driver, circuit, sponsor or rights holder.
disclaimer.s1p1: “Formula 1”, “F1”, “FORMULA ONE”, “FIA FORMULA ONE WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP”, “Grand Prix” and related marks belong to their respective owners, including Formula One Licensing B.V. References to these names, teams, drivers and circuits are made only for identification, commentary and historical context.
disclaimer.s1p2: Apex does not use official Formula 1 branding, team marks or sponsor marks as its own identity. A name appearing in a data record does not imply partnership, approval or affiliation.
disclaimer.s2p1: Results and timing information are presented for informational purposes and may be delayed, incomplete or corrected. Source attribution is provided where applicable; source providers remain responsible for their own data and terms.
disclaimer.s2p2: Apex prefers original vector illustrations, silhouettes, circuit diagrams and assets with a documented permissive licence. No Getty, AFP, Reuters or other unlicensed press photography is intentionally commissioned or presented as Apex-owned media.
disclaimer.s3p1: For a brand, attribution or affiliation concern, contact <mail>contact@apexstats.example</mail>. This address must be replaced with a monitored production mailbox before public launch.

terms.title: Terms for using Apex.
terms.intro: By accessing Apex, you agree to use this independent service lawfully and responsibly. Apex is an informational archive, not an official timing, betting, safety, engineering or professional advice service.
terms.s1p1: You may browse, link to and quote reasonable portions of public editorial content with clear attribution. You may not scrape, overload, reverse engineer, impersonate Apex, bypass access controls or use the service for unlawful, abusive, misleading or commercial resale purposes without written permission.
terms.s2p1: Data can be delayed, unavailable or corrected. Do not rely on Apex for decisions involving safety, wagering, finance or contractual obligations. We may change, suspend or remove content and features when needed for security, maintenance, source corrections or legal compliance.
terms.s3p1: Community or source material must respect copyright, privacy, publicity and trade-mark rights. To report an unlawful, inaccurate or infringing item, contact <mail>contact@apexstats.example</mail>. We review good-faith reports and may request supporting details.
terms.s4p1: To the extent permitted by law, Apex is provided “as is” without guarantees of uninterrupted availability, completeness, suitability or error-free data. Nothing here limits rights that cannot lawfully be excluded under applicable consumer or data-protection law.

dmca.metaDescription: Copyright notice and takedown process for Apex.
dmca.title: Copyright and takedown requests.
dmca.intro: Apex respects copyright and wants every asset to have a documented source and licence. If you believe content on this site infringes your rights, send a complete notice so we can investigate and act quickly.
dmca.s1i1: Your name, contact details and authority to act for the rights holder.
dmca.s1i2: A description of the copyrighted work and the exact Apex URL or asset path.
dmca.s1i3: A good-faith statement that the use is not authorised by the rights holder, its agent or law.
dmca.s1i4: A statement that the information is accurate and, where applicable, a signature.
dmca.s2p1: Email the notice to <mail>dmca@apexstats.example</mail>. This address is a pre-launch placeholder and must be replaced by a monitored designated agent address before the service is publicly launched.
dmca.s3p1: We acknowledge valid notices, preserve relevant records, restrict or remove the reported material while investigating, and contact the submitting party if clarification is needed. Counter-notices and repeat-infringer decisions are handled under applicable law. A mistaken or abusive notice can cause harm, so provide only truthful, specific information.
